days.title: Arrive in London
days.summary: Hotel check-in and an intentionally easy first evening for jet-lag recovery.

reservations.title: Wombat’s City Hostel
reservations.publicDetail: 7 Dock Street, London E1 8JN · five-night stay · private confirmation details remain outside public trip data.

activities.title: Arrive at London Heathrow
activities.description: Clear immigration, collect bags and follow signs for the Elizabeth line.

activities.title: Transfer to Wombat’s
activities.description: Take an eastbound Elizabeth line train to Whitechapel, then walk approximately 12–15 minutes to the hotel. A taxi is the low-effort final-leg alternative with luggage.

activities.title: Check in and keep the evening light
activities.description: Choose a short walk and an easy nearby dinner rather than committing to another major sight on the first night.

activities.title: Nearby arrival-night choices
activities.description: Beigel Bake for a casual Brick Lane bite, or Wilton’s Music Hall for a historic nearby drink.

notes.text: Treat the timing as flexible after immigration. The goal is to settle in, eat something easy and protect the following day’s early start.
Before bed, pick up water and train snacks near Leman Street for the next morning’s long Chatsworth journey.
